sections.section: RULES - Environment Protection Department Service Rules 1997
sections.description:
ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION DEPARTMENT
ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION DEPARTMENT
SERVICE RULES, 1997
(Amendment of Sched.)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
21st November, 2012]
No.
SOR-III(S&GAD)1-24/2007(P), dated 20-3-2012.---In exercise of the powers
conferred under section 23 of the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974 (VIII of
1974), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Environment
Protection Department Service Rules, 1997, the following further amendments
shall be made:
In
the said rules, in the Schedule, at Sr. No. 6, against the posts of
"Assistant Director Field / DOE / DDOE (BS-17)", for the existing
entries in column No. 5, the following shall be substituted:
"(i) M.Sc/B.S. (second division) in
Environmental Sciences from a recognized University; or
(ii) B.Sc
(second division) in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering or
Agricultural Engineering from a recognized University; or
(iii) Master's
degree (second division) in Environmental Management or equivalent from a
recognized University."
